firstScreen.notes: 1440-first.jpg: stacked h1 'Formosan termites in New Orleans' over a full-width 21:9 dusk skyline strip, as the concept promised; one filled primary 'Book a swarm visit' plus phone in header and button; the next band peeks at the bottom. The ZIP field is gone, so there are two actions. Still no outcome in the h1, and the proof line under the buttons is 2 lines of small grey text that is easy to miss. 390-first.jpg: h1 2 lines, strip, sub and both buttons above the fold.

distinctiveness.notes: The dusk clock is now the spine: a fixed margin clock reads 8:22 (1440-scroll-25.jpg), 8:47 (1440-scroll-50.jpg), 9:13 (1440-scroll-75.jpg); every section and every review carries its own time stamp, and the footer lands on '9:30 pm. Porch light back on.' (1440-rm-full.jpg). Skyline silhouette in hero and break. Nothing in pest-A or the library shares this. One mono tracked eyebrow remains ('SAMPLE REVIEWS, NEW ORLEANS', 1440-scroll-75.jpg).

type.notes: Curly quotes and en-dash ranges now (1440-scroll-75.jpg, 1440-first.jpg). 'The street goes dark. The swarm moves on to the next light.' is a real scale-contrast moment (1440-rm-full.jpg). Garamond italic reviews with italic time stamps are the best type on the page (1440-scroll-75.jpg). The house-card descriptions are small grey Karla on near-black and read faint (1440-scroll-25.jpg) (-0.5).

layout.notes: Services are now a ruled list with a split 'Termites / Everything else', not a card grid (1440-scroll-50.jpg): good. Tone order holds and the gold guarantee band breaks the dark run (1440-rm-full.jpg). But in the house-type story the left column is empty at 1440 once its heading scrolls away, and each card is followed by ~260px of empty band (1440-scroll-25.jpg) (-1.0 blank space). The area section's right frame is an empty gradient box (1440-rm-full.jpg) (-0.5).

photo.notes: There is still no photography. dist/media/*.jpg are all byte-identical 16,907-byte placeholders, multiply-blended out of sight under line-drawn SVG houses and a skyline (1440-first.jpg, 1440-scroll-25.jpg). The illustration system is coherent and in the brand duotone, which is why this is up from 5, but the category asks for media made to feel like one shoot, and the area frame is an empty gradient (1440-rm-full.jpg). Captions ('Probe checking the sill plate') describe photos that are not visible (1440-scroll-25.jpg).

copy.notes: Local, specific and honest: 'Swarmers at the porch light don't always mean they're in the walls' (1440-first.jpg), 'Each visit ends with what was applied and where. You keep the product label.' (1440-scroll-50.jpg), 'Names and stories are samples.' (1440-scroll-75.jpg). 'From real porches' is gone. Service links now say what they do ('Price my Formosan plan', 'Book a damage check'). Sample labels on the rating and every review.

mobile.notes: 390-first.jpg: designed and not just collapsed, with the strip between h1 and sub and full-width stacked actions. 390-rm-full.jpg: house cards, service list, price table and price tool stack cleanly; render.json overflow is clean at 320 and 390. The lights-out helper is now full-width bordered rows, not 13px checkboxes (390-rm-full.jpg).

a11y.notes: 1440-rm-full.jpg and 390-rm-full.jpg show every section and word with reduced motion. One h1, ordered headings. But every visible frame has alt text that describes a photograph ('Hand probing foundation perimeter with flashlight' on the hero, which shows a skyline drawing, 1440-first.jpg; dist/index.html img[data-slot]): screen-reader users are told about images sighted users never see. mustFix.

motion.notes: The clock rail advances with scroll and the time reads differently in every frame (1440-scroll-25.jpg 8:22, 1440-scroll-50.jpg 8:47, 1440-scroll-75.jpg 9:13): the story is now visible motion, not a hook. The skyline windows are lit in the hero and the break. The promised lamp-glow dimming per house card is not visible across the 25% frame (the cards all show the same glow, 1440-scroll-25.jpg) (-0.5); the sections still enter with the same fade (1440-full.jpg).

wow.notes: The 'street goes dark' break with the skyline and the time-stamped reviews (1440-rm-full.jpg, 1440-scroll-75.jpg) are moments a contractor would screenshot. The tool is still a plain dropdown giving one line ('Termite inspection: $95 to $175', 1440-rm-full.jpg) and does not visualise anything.

polish.notes: Favicon, OG, print and forced-colors are present (dist/index.html). Radii are consistent and the glass disc is gone (1440-first.jpg). The area frame is an empty gradient box with a caption (1440-rm-full.jpg), and the dist ships seven identical placeholder jpgs.

mustFix.problem: There is still no photography: all media files are identical 16,907-byte placeholders hidden under SVG drawings, and the area frame is empty. Photo cannot reach 8.5 like this.
mustFix.fix: Escalate to the orchestrator: the pest niche needs a real approved media library. Then either place real graded frames, or, if the drawings stay, remove the placeholder elements and fill the area frame with the skyline/house drawing system.

mustFix.problem: The alt text and captions describe photographs ('Hand probing foundation perimeter with flashlight', 'Probe checking the sill plate') that are not visible; the visible content is line drawings.
mustFix.fix: Make alt and figcaption match what is on screen (e.g. 'Line drawing of a Creole cottage with three check points: sill, ridge vent, side vent'), or set alt='' on the decorative drawing and keep the meaning in the list beside it.

elevate.move: Commit to one frame language: real frames graded into the indigo/streetlamp duotone and clipped inside the house-outline silhouettes, so each house type in the story is a photo seen through the drawing, which shows the work and the concept in the same image.

Turn the house-type story into a true pinned stage: the left column holds the large clock and the house drawing, which morphs shotgun to Creole to camelback to slab while the right column steps through the checks, so no column is ever empty and the dead bands between cards disappear.
